unit.name: System of Particles and Rotational Motion

chapter: System of Particles and Rotational Motion
question_text: What is the moment of inertia of a rod of mass M and length L about an axis perpendicular to the rod and passing through one end?

verification.note: Sri Chaitanya IPE Junior Fastrack (Rev. May 2024), Unit 7 SHORT ANSWER. The mark split is invented and needs a Telangana IPE teacher; no exam appearance years are printed, so appearances[] stays empty.

recall_prompt: Say the steps you would write for this answer, in order. You can speak in English, in Telugu, or in both.

steps.label: The known result
lines: its CENTRE, a uniform rod has
steps.margin_note: Name the axis of the known result precisely — through the centre, perpendicular to the rod.
steps.why: The strategy of this whole question class: quote the centre-of-mass result, then carry it to the asked axis with the parallel axes theorem.
common_mistakes: Quoting ML²/3 here — that is the answer, not the starting point.

recall.must_convey: That the rod about its centre has I₀ = ML²/12.
accept: I naught is M L square by 12

steps.memory_tip: Centre gives the 12, end gives the 3. Start from the 12 every time.

steps.label: Shift the axis
lines: The end axis is parallel to the centre
axis, at a distance a = L/2. By the
steps.margin_note: State a = L/2 before substituting — the distance is the only thing that can go wrong here.
steps.why: The theorem does the work the integral would otherwise do. Note the end axis I is LARGER — mass sits farther from an end than from the middle, on average.
common_mistakes: Taking a = L instead of L/2.
Subtracting Ma² — the parallel axes theorem always ADDS.

recall.must_convey: That the parallel axes theorem with a = L/2 gives ML²/12 + ML²/4.
accept: I naught plus M a squared

steps.memory_tip: M(L/2)² = ML²/4. Square the whole of L/2, the 2 as well as the L.

steps.label: The result
steps.margin_note: 1/12 + 1/4 = 1/12 + 3/12 = 4/12 = 1/3. Show the fraction line if time allows.
steps.why: Four times the centre value — a useful sanity anchor worth remembering for MCQ papers too.

recall.must_convey: That the moment of inertia about the end is ML²/3.

steps.memory_tip: For M = 1 kg and L = 1 m: 0.083 about the centre, 0.333 about the end.

insider_note: The parallel-axes step carries 2 of the 4 marks, and naming a = L/2 in words before substituting is what is checked there.
